name: npc_shogun-guard-01
customDialogue:
Every faction's envoy passes this gate sooner or later.
The Shogun sees them all.

name: npc_shogun-sensei-01
customDialogue:
Discipline is a wall you build inside yourself.
The castle walls are the easy part.

name: npc_shogun-steward-01
customDialogue:
The Shogun speaks rarely, and never twice.
Listen the first time.

name: npc_shogun-scholar-01
customDialogue:
The court records every tremor.
And every silence after one.

name: npc_shogun-villager-01
customDialogue:
The wisteria in the Throne Room has not flowered in years.
My grandmother says it is waiting for something.

hotspots.description:
Twelve seats: eleven villages and the colony, each under its own banner.

The Shogun does not sit at the table but above it, so that every voice reaches the throne equally.
Power through wisdom. The crown on the throne's back is the Shogun's mark; the seat beneath it has been empty since the colony divided.
Planted the day the first council met. The old Shogun said it would flower in full only when all twelve seats were filled again.
You lay the reports side by side at the head of the Table: the emptied stores, the cracked circle, the breathing vents. Eleven banners hang over eleven empty seats.

A scroll waits beside the throne, sealed with the crown. Inside there is no order and no word, only the Shogun's seal pressed three times: once for each report. The Shogun has heard. The Shogun will not speak yet.

BY THE SHOGUN, TO EVERY FACTION: From tonight each village keeps one watch over the old tunnels, and every watch reports to the Hub. No village marches on another. No road is closed against another. Whatever wakes below, the colony faces it together.

hotspots.description:
Three tiers: the clerks who write, the scribes who copy, the magistrate who decides.

The petitioner kneels on the straw mat in the white court below, where nothing can be hidden.
Every judgement is pressed with the Shogun's seal in red. A copy goes into a drawer on these walls, and stays there for ever.
Each drawer holds the records of one family of the colony. The ladders roll along the brass rails; the clerks know every drawer by heart.
Ninth tremor this moon. Silence after it: forty breaths. The envoys of three villages left before it ended.
Tenth tremor. Silence after it: ninety breaths. No one left. No one spoke. The Shogun did not move.

hotspots.description: Purple lacing on black iron. It was worn at the founding of the colony and never since.
The chests under the stairs hold the colony's reserve: rice notes, gold, and the seals of every village.
From here the first Shogun watched the villages rise. On a clear evening you can count every roof in the valley.

From the top of the keep the whole valley lies below: every village roof, every road, and far off the great cherry of the Hub. The first Shogun climbed up here to count the villages. There were twelve then.

hotspots.description: Eleven villages in gold round the Hub, every road and river between them. The generals move lacquer markers across it; tonight the markers are all at home.
Four helmets for the four generals of the Shogunate. A general who leaves the council leaves the helmet on its stand.

spotConfig.label: Read the summons
spotConfig.text: BY THE SHOGUN: Every faction shall bring what it knows, not what it fears, to the Shogun Table. Until the Table has spoken, no village marches, no road is closed, and nothing from below is sold.

spotConfig.label: Look under the bridge
spotConfig.text: Something glints under the arch, wedged between the stones: a gold coin stamped with the crown. Under the gold, an older stamp shows through: a ring of roots.

requires.hint: A fine view of the valley. The guards say it is finer at dusk.

spotConfig.text: At dusk the valley fills with purple light, and for a moment every village roof between here and the Hub glows the same colour.

requires.hint: Just stairs. The castle guards say they turn gold at sunrise.

spotConfig.text: At dawn the light climbs the great stairs one step at a time, and the whole castle wakes behind it.

spotConfig.label: Ring the shrine bell three times
spotConfig.text: On the third ring, a stone behind the shrine answers with a hollow knock. Cut into the castle rock there: a ring of roots around a closed eye, older than the castle built on top of it.

spotConfig.label: Look closer
spotConfig.text: A tiny ant peeks out at you.
